messages:
maria: Heads-up — BigCorp asked for a pin on model-x to avoid recent regen diffs. I think we should treat this as a cohort-priority request (not global pin) unless evals show major regressions. opinions?
aj: What's the customer SLA ask? Do they want hard latency guarantees or just output stability?
maria: Sales says: no quality regressions + 3mo grace path. They want stability of responses more than latency guarantees. My straw proposal: pin if >5% of their eval prompts regress on quality OR if we see >10% median latency increase for their typical seq lengths.
taylor: I can run the evals. Which sets? customer prompt set + our canonical quality suite ok? Will queue tonight.
sam: Capacity note: pinning model-x to Dedicated reduces our scheduling flexibility. Need to know which hardware bucket, and the cost impact. Also need a rollback plan in case of downstream issues.
jordan: Add a metric for embed drift / hallucination spike (precision@k drop). We should monitor that alongside quality regressions. +1 to using customer prompts.
maria: Action items: 1) Taylor run quality + perf bench on customer cohort; 2) Sam estimate infra impact & cost delta; 3) Jordan draft rollback runbook + detection hooks. If any criteria fail, propose 30-day compatibility shim (opt-in) with logging. Can we get results by EOD tomorrow?
taylor: On it. Starting the runs: `./eval/run_quality.sh --cohort bigcorp --suite canonical --output artifacts/bigcorp_eval.json` will post artifacts when done.
deploy-bot: infra-quota-check: dedicated-GPU capacity check completed — dedicated-GPU slots available next week for 2x standard V100-equivalent pools.
sam: Thanks. I'll model cost scenarios and post numbers in this thread. If we pin, recommend canary plan: 5% traffic x 48h, then 25% x 72h, then full rollout if canary metrics stable.
aj: If canary passes, who signs off on full rollout? PM + Eng + CS?
maria: Signoffs: PM (me) + Eng (Aj) + CS (Lina). I'll loop Lina and file the customer req in Salesforce. Thanks all.
jordan: One more — add automatic diff alerts to token-level scoring so we can detect subtle regressions during canary.
maria: Good call. Adding to action items.
